errors.what: Driver speed is wrong. The spec says one revolution per 4 s, which is 30 deg per 1/3 s frame. The panel and the crank show only 9 deg per frame, so about 27 deg/s, or roughly 0.3x speed (one revolution takes about 13.3 s). At t=1.00 the driver should be at 90 deg but shows 27 deg, and at t=3.67 it should be at 330 deg but shows 99 deg. The wheel indexing therefore finishes at t≈1.67 instead of t=0.5 s (phi=45 deg), and the dwell phase is stretched. The geometry, rotation directions and wheel/driver phase relation are otherwise consistent with the spec.
